app.title: Rvoip: VoIP stack in Rust
app.description: A pure Rust implementation of a VoIP stack supporting SIP, RTP, and related protocols.
proposed_tests: Run `cargo build --release` and measure compile time
Execute the provided demo application and capture a SIP INVITE flow
Send 100 RTP packets to a test server and measure packet loss
Measure CPU and memory usage during a 5‑minute call
